'''Jek Pugilio''' was a soft-spoken [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Glova]] who served the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. While stationed at [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] on the [[Water/Legends|snowy]] world of [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], Pugilio was asked by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Carlist Rieekan/Legends|Carlist Rieekan]] to join [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Group]] as [[Tenk Lenso]]'s [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]], as post-traumatic stress prevented Lenso from gunning himself. The two fought in the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] as [[Rogue Eleven/Legends|Rogue Eleven]], but their [[Snowspeeder/Legends|snowspeeder]] was shot down by the Empire's [[Blizzard Force/Legends|Blizzard Force]] of [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-AT]] [[Walker/Legends|walkers]]. Both were among the first pilots to be [[Death/Legends|killed]] in action.<ref name="Warfare" />
[[File:Rogue_Group_TESB_Manga.jpg|250px|thumb|The twelve airspeeders of Rogue Group, including gunner Pugilio, attack during the Battle of Hoth.]]

==Behind the scenes==
Jek Pugilio has a generic white helmet with blue rebel logos, but instead of an orange visor he has a black visor like pilots with the same helmet at the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].
